season.evidence: Logged summits Jun 3, Jul 8, Aug 10; web search of trip reports (Southern Pickets) shows July to August as the usual window, July with more snow cover; no official source found. Stored Jun-Sep and mid-July to early September text kept as is.

Visits another peak and not a trailhead round trip.

notes: Only one harvested track, a Terror plus Degenhardt camp-based linkup. Nothing assigned and no facts, as its report is a June outing on a different ridge variation.
